method.categories: exclusive name/scope heuristics; categories sum to kernel duration, not elapsed wall time
method.idle: wall minus union of recorded kernel/memory intervals; includes host delay and trace overhead
method.overlap: kernel sum minus interval union; not a measure of SM occupancy or critical-path cost
method.profiling: profiled durations can differ from unprofiled benchmark medians
method.scope_limit: CUDA command-buffer replay can erase op scopes; zero attributed MLP/loss time does not mean no MLP/loss work
method.selection: GPU Stream # tracks only; kernel_details identifies kernels; Memcpy/Memset count only toward memory/GPU activity
method.timestamp_unit: Chrome trace ts/dur are microseconds, regardless of displayTimeUnit
method.windows: clipped to nonoverlapping synchronized host update annotations; gaps between updates excluded
